payload.summary: Six owner-reviewed ledger sources carry metadata the publisher pages contradict, including the RANZCP mood guideline marked current when the College retired it
payload.detail: Re-read from the publishers' own pages on 2026-09-16. (1) ranzcp-mood-disorders-clinical-practice-guideline has documentStatus current; the guideline's own RANZCP page states it is more than five years old, no longer considered current guidance, and retained for reference use only. Proposed: outdated. (2) Five Chief Psychiatrist guidelines (mha-compliance, inpatient-and-community-treatment-orders, examination-locations, treatment-support-and-discharge-plans, further-opinions) carry publicationDate 2025-12-19, which is neither the publisher's Date published (1 December 2015) nor its Last updated (17 December 2025). An update date used as a publication date is what docs/source-acquisition-protocol.md forbids, and it overstates the Currency dimension (weight 15) by about ten years. Proposed: publicationDate 2015-12-01 and version 'December 2025 revision'. All six records are validationStatus locally_reviewed signed off 2026-09-06, so applying a correction changes what that sign-off attested; the owner applies and re-attests rather than an agent. Eleven corrections with quoted publisher text in the 2026-09-16 Therapy handover work bundle (ledger-metadata-corrections.json). Verify with npm run check:source-acquisitions.
payload.source: PsychSift Therapy Claude cloud handover session, 2026-09-16, branch claude/vibrant-mccarthy-bbi43k
